planSteps.description: Switch role to 'จัดการเมนู (Menu Admin)' from the role switcher
Menu Admin panel displays list of all dishes, search box, category tabs, and 'เพิ่มเมนูใหม่ (Add Dish)' button
Click 'เพิ่มเมนูใหม่ (Add Dish)' button
Item Editor modal opens with fields for Name TH/EN, Price, Category, Image URL, Description, and Option Groups
Click 'จัดการหมวดหมู่ (Manage Categories)' button
Category Modal opens displaying all active categories with edit, delete, and icon selector tools
Close category modal and search for 'Matcha' in the menu search input
Menu list filters to show matching Matcha items with quick edit and delete action buttons
